product: Sinusoidal History — ten historical cycle theories drawn as sinusoids against paired empirical series
_disclosureNote: This repo is PUBLIC, so this manifest is written for a public reader: it states the controls that are in place and names what is absent as a plain fact, without enumerating how to exploit anything.

runtime.packageManager: npm; package-lock.json committed, CI installs with npm ci

deploy.trigger: auto-deploy on every push to main. The deploy is NOT gated on CI, so a push is a release whether or not CI goes green.

datastores.note: public/data/*.csv series and src/data/*.json cycle definitions, committed and served statically. Every derived CSV has a scripts/build_<slug>.py that reproduces it from upstream. No database.

authModel: none. No accounts, no sessions, no cookies, no user data of any kind.

publicEndpoints.note: read-only JSON: each cycle's computed phase for a year

secrets.runtime: none. Nothing under src/ reads process.env; the site needs no credential to build or serve.
secrets.operatorCredentials: read-only analytics reads (Render request logs, Search Console) run from the operator's machine with credentials held outside this repo, never in Actions secrets

requiredChecks.enforcement: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml) on push and pull request to main
requiredChecks.ci: npm ci, then lint, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), vitest, next build — the same four gates this repo previously ran only by hand
preCommit: node scripts/check-staged-secrets.mjs — refuses a commit whose staged added lines carry secret-shaped content
additional: python scripts/audit_cycle_rationales.py before shipping any prose that names a year and a cycle phase (a human-read table, not a CI gate)
scripts/spectral_verdict.py pins its input-CSV sha256s in a manifest and aborts on mismatch

secretScanning.preCommit: present — core.hooksPath is .githooks (set by npm install's prepare script) and the hook runs scripts/check-staged-secrets.mjs, a byte-exact copy of the fleet scanner. A fresh clone that never runs npm install has no hook.
secretScanning.pushProtection: enabled 2026-09-16 — GitHub refuses a push carrying a detected secret, covering what the local hook cannot see: a clone that never ran npm install, another machine, an edit made in the web UI
secretScanning.dependabotAlerts: disabled — so this repo cannot report a dependency-risk count at all; check-engineering-zero reads it as unreadable, never as zero. 27 direct dependencies, 638 resolved packages in the lockfile.

branchProtection.main: none — single-contributor repo, work lands directly on main

errorMonitoring.note: A static reference site with no client instrumentation by design: no analytics script, no cookie, no consent surface.

observability.tier1: organic search clicks by page, read through the portfolio Search Console client
observability.tier2: scripts/crawl-read.mjs over Render request logs, monthly — answers who crawls the site, never who reads it
